title: Design System: Geminus
status: Awaiting the owner's review (H-013); not approved.

veil.note: Translucent; the ramp steps its opaque base.

veil-dark.note: Translucent; the ramp steps its opaque base.

display.purpose: Full-screen Compare only: panel title, medians, Δ, rug median values.

headline.purpose: Panel and dialog titles, proposal claim values; the brand at 700.

title.purpose: Popover and outcome headings, phone step-list heading and model title.

figure.purpose: Every result number; inputs and steppers; never below 15 px.

body.purpose: Default text, node text, row labels, segmented items, notes.

control.purpose: Buttons and links; 600 on primary buttons and toggled segments.

label.purpose: Field and provenance labels, captions, units, help; 600 on chips, tags, table headers.

axis.purpose: Time numbers and labels on the Marey time axis, at 87.5% width.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Popovers, menus, the issues drawer, dialogs, the palette and toasts (light).

shadows.name: overlay-dark
shadows.purpose: The same surfaces in dark; the 1px ring gives the edge a shadow cannot on gray-black.

shadows.name: selection-ring
shadows.purpose: A selected node or pool, with its border in Graphite Ink. A state, not a depth.

shadows.name: invalid-field
shadows.purpose: Doubles the Error Red border on an invalid input.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Hover, press, border and overlay transitions.

motion.name: overlay-enter
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1 and translateY(4px) to none, 180ms ease-standard
motion.purpose: Popovers, menus, drawers, dialogs, the palette veil.

motion.name: playhead-reduced
motion.purpose: Marey playback under prefers-reduced-motion; all transitions off.

breakpoints.name: desktop-compact
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: panel 360 px, scrubber 120 px, Compare cells 3 px, intervals at 75% width.

breakpoints.name: desktop-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: the strip key drops its reading hint; lower-priority provenance groups leave.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: scrolling page, Simulate and Review only, panel first, step list replaces the canvas.

narrative.overview:
Geminus is drawn like Marey's graphic train timetable: time runs left to right, the steps of a process stand top to bottom, and every item moving through the process is a line through them. A line going flat is an item waiting in a queue; a steep line is an item moving. The interface is one white timetable sheet laid on a pale neutral shell and inked in graphite, with exactly two data inks: dashed graphite for the baseline and solid deep green for the scenario. Amber warnings, red errors and gray structure stay out of their way.

The density is that of a working instrument for people who model all day and decide in 30 to 60 minute sittings: 13.5 px body text, 32 px controls, hairline rules, small corners, no decoration. Depth belongs only to what floats over the work (popovers, menus, drawers, dialogs, the palette, toasts); the sheet, the canvas objects and the panel are flat and separated by line. Provenance is part of the furniture: the version, draft, scenario and runs on screen are always named, and the canvas says whether it shows the editable draft or a read-only version.

Dark is the same timetable on a gray-black slate with chalk ink. Its neutrals have zero chroma, the scenario green lightens to a chalk green, and the line grammar does not change. The theme follows the system by default; the person can switch it and the choice is remembered. The world refuses the category default for modelling tools: a dot-grid canvas of floating soft-shadow cards with one blue accent.

The system is domain-neutral. The prototype's example data is the Software Delivery example pack (steps such as Code review, CI, QA test and Deploy; time in eight-hour working days; lead time and throughput). The P0 domain is now the electronics assembly/test line (H-016, ADR-025), and its screens are not designed yet. Examples quoted below come from the prototype and are marked as such. Step and resource names, the time unit, metric names and domain icons come from the DomainPack; no component may assume one domain.

This record is taken from the shipped workspace prototype (`checks/evidence/2026-10-19-T-045/prototypes/workspace.html`, finish review disposition ship, 2026-10-19). **Status: awaiting the owner's review (H-013); this system is not approved.** Token keys are the system's own names. Each color has a `-dark` sibling; components reference the light key, which resolves to its sibling in dark. The app's current tokens (`apps/web/ui/tokens.css`) predate this direction and do not follow it yet; mapping these keys onto ADR-021's `--gm-*` custom properties is left to the app task.
keyCharacteristics: Two data inks with a fixed grammar: baseline dashed graphite, scenario solid deep green. The dash carries the difference; the hue confirms it.
One family, Archivo, with tabular lining figures everywhere, five sizes, and narrower widths before smaller sizes.
A flat white sheet, hairline rules, 4 to 8 px corners with capsules for resources and counts; shadows only on overlays.
Provenance always on screen; the mode's primary action sits beside the object it acts on.
A gray-black dark theme with zero-chroma neutrals; the default follows the system.
One palette and one line grammar across every projection of the model: the 2D canvas, the Marey strip, Compare, and the read-only 3D view when it lands.
Domain-neutral furniture: vocabulary, time unit, metrics and domain icons come from the DomainPack.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Baseline is dashed graphite and scenario is solid deep green, in every chart, bar, key and legend. The two inks are only 1.5:1 apart in light and 1.25:1 in dark, so the dash carries the difference and hue is the second cue, never the only one.

rules.name: The Green Means Scenario Rule
rules.body: Green marks the scenario run or a passed check and nothing else: never brand, selection, links, focus or decoration. Selection and focus are Graphite Ink.

rules.name: The Gray-Black Rule
rules.body: Every dark neutral, from the inset well (#0D0D0D) to Chalk Ink (#EBEBEB), has zero chroma: no blue, no warm cast. In dark every wash collapses to one neutral gray (#242424) and hue lives only in ink and edge.

rules.name: The Five Sizes Rule
rules.body: Five sizes only: 12, 13.5, 15, 18 and 22 px. Hierarchy comes from weight (400, 500, 600) and from Graphite Ink against Secondary Graphite, never from a sixth size.

rules.name: The Fifteen-Pixel Figure Rule
rules.body: A result number is never smaller than 15 px. Twelve pixels is for what the number is, not for the number.

rules.name: The Narrow Before Small Rule
rules.body: When room runs out, Archivo narrows (87.5% for Compare row names at 1366 px and below and for the phone's timetable labels, 75% for intervals at 1366 px and below) before any size drops.

rules.name: The Action Beside Its Object Rule
rules.body: The mode's primary action ends the provenance row, next to the version, draft or scenario it acts on ("Publish v4…" in Edit, "Run S-2 again" in Simulate). A what-if run and a version action never share a slot.

rules.name: The Provenance Always Rule
rules.body: On every desktop mode the provenance row names the version, draft, scenario and runs, and the canvas caption says what the canvas shows (the editable draft and its base, or a read-only version with its patch), plus seed, engine, dataset and whether the data is synthetic.

rules.name: The Overlays Only Rule
rules.body: Only what floats over the work casts a shadow. Nodes are never lifted; a node on a soft shadow is the category default this world refuses.

rules.name: The Square Steps, Round Resources Rule
rules.body: Steps are 4 px rectangles; resource pools are capsules. Shape alone tells a step from a pool on the canvas.

dos: Do draw every baseline as dashed Baseline Graphite and every scenario as solid Deep Scenario Green, in charts, node bars, keys and legends alike (The Two Inks Rule).
Do write a change as baseline → scenario with the scenario value in green at 600, and give Δ, Δ% and the 90% interval beside the median.
Do keep the provenance row and the canvas caption on screen in every desktop mode, and label synthetic and sampled data where it is shown.
Do end the provenance row with the mode's primary action: Publish in Graphite Ink, a scenario run in Deep Scenario Green.
Do draw any boundary that identifies a control or a model object in Control Edge (at least 3:1); keep Hairline Rule for dividing content.
Do keep a blocked action focusable as `aria-disabled` with its reason written beside it.
Do narrow Archivo to 87.5% or 75% before reducing a size, and step every role up one size for full-screen Compare.
Do animate state changes only, at 180 ms with `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`; under reduced motion, switch transitions off and let the playhead jump one time unit at a time.
Do take step names, resource names, the time unit, metric names and domain icons from the DomainPack.
donts: Don't tell baseline and scenario apart by hue alone; the two inks are barely 1.5:1 apart.
Don't use green for brand, selection, links, focus or decoration; it means scenario or passed.
Don't let any blue or tinted neutral into the dark theme; its neutrals stay zero-chroma gray-black.
Don't put a dot grid or graph paper behind the model canvas, and don't float nodes on soft shadows; the only grid in the world is the Marey time grid.
Don't use Disabled Graphite for anything but disabled text.
Don't add a sixth type size, a second Latin family or a monospace face.
Don't mark an active option or row with a colored stripe; use Selected Row Tint and weight.
Don't offer topology editing on a phone; the phone shows results and proposal review only.
Don't build one domain's vocabulary, units or icons into a component; the prototype's Software Delivery names are example data, not the system.
